title: Bump dependencies in Go services
author: pellared
body:
### Background 

I noticed that the `pb.go` files where not regenerated for a long time and thus the generated code was using deprecated Go module (`github.com/golang/protobuf`)

I think that without regenerating it might not even work with `google.golang.org/grpc v1.66.0`. At least this is what I noticed when working on https://github.com/signalfx/microservices-demo/pull/152.

### Fixes 
<!-- Link the issue(s) this PR fixes-->
N/A

### Change Summary
<!-- Short summary of the changes submitted -->

- Bump Go version in `go.mod` files to `1.23` (the `Dockerfile` are already using Go 1.23.
- Update the `genproto.sh` so that it works fine with latest protoc tooling. References:
  - https://grpc.io/docs/languages/go/quickstart/
  - https://protobuf.dev/reference/go/go-generated/

### Additional Notes

- nit: I also replaced `as` to `AS` in Dockerfiles to get rid of `docker build` warning
